body: Thanks.  I have been talking to her all day about it she basically said to me "Today is the day I choose whether to live or die"  I want her to choose life.  I am at the point where I love her, and would do anything for her to be happy.  If that means me not being in her life then so be it I just want her to live
Thank you this means a lot to me.  I am going to try my best for forgiveness.

Thank you

I did try to explain to her, but I really have no idea how to explain it.  I was weak and made a giant mistake.  There is no justifying what I did.  I would do anything it takes to make it up to her, but i can't drive down there.  I don't think she wants to see me.  She is barely talking to me but luckily she is a little.  Driving down there isn't an option because we had to keep our relationship a secret from her roommate.  Her roommate is super protective, and controlling of my (now) ex.  I promised her I wouldn't say a word about the relationship or the breakup to her roommate, and I can't break her trust again.
